environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' running with IAM Role 'arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/UserServiceRole'. The role has a policy granting dynamodb:Scan and dynamodb:GetItem on table 'UserProfiles' with no condition keys. Pod runs in a flat network with no NetworkPolicy applied. Any pod in the cluster can reach port 50051. The DynamoDB table contains all user records including SSN and salary fields for admin, HR, and regular users.
